# Ahmed Nasser — Frontend Developer

> Frontend Developer in Cairo, Egypt with 4+ years building production React.js and Next.js apps. Core stack: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript. Builds enterprise SaaS dashboards with a focus on performance and security, for clients in Saudi Arabia and Egypt. Available for work.

## Skills

- Core: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript
- Secondary: Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, REST, WebSockets, Vitest, Playwright
- Interface: Figma to code, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), i18next and RTL
- Components: Next.js App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, SSR, SSG, ISR, design systems, clean architecture
- Data: TanStack Query, WebSockets, Pusher, React Hook Form + Zod, RBAC
- Security: XSS and CSRF prevention, Content Security Policy, input validation, dependency audits
- Performance: Core Web Vitals, code splitting, lazy loading, re-render optimization, technical SEO, GEO, AIO
- AI & quality: Claude Code, OpenCode, AI coding agents, Vitest, Playwright, GitLab CI/CD

## Experience

- E2E County (Jan 2026 – Present, on-site, Cairo): sole frontend developer on Cyber-Guardian, a threat-intelligence SaaS (full Next.js frontend, RBAC with Admin/Analyst/Viewer tiers, advanced data tables, breach-trend analytics); team projects: TravWare SaaS ERP interfaces used in production by travel clients (with product, Laravel backend and design teams), including a fix for a page that froze at 2,000 rows; TravWare flights & hotels booking engine with per-client branding; co-developed a social media management dashboard.
- INCode (Feb 2024 – Dec 2025, hybrid, Cairo): sole frontend developer owning production releases, change requests and hotfixes; Olimi.ai (Voice AI, first client Paymob) and Beesly AI dashboards; built Elli, an enterprise school management platform, single-handedly in about 6 months (first adopted by Forsan International Schools); led two junior developers on a multi-tenant restaurant system for three brands.
- Mazeed (Apr 2022 – Feb 2024, remote): migrated legacy HTML, Bootstrap and jQuery products to React in a team of 4 frontend developers, for Saudi clients including Monsha'at and Takaful; optimized Core Web Vitals across all platforms; mentored a junior developer.
- Freelance (part-time, by referral): Ajzaa multi-tenant marketplace dashboard, Baian AI invoice extraction, Rayan Hajj water distribution platform, Next.js SSR tourism platforms (Kenzy Tours and First Mas rank on Google for Hajj, Umrah and tourism searches).
